ayahs.2: Is kitaab ka utaarna Allah Taala ghaalib hikmat wale ki taraf se hai.
ayahs.3: Hum ne aasmanon aur zameen aur un dono ke darmiyan ki tamaam cheezon ko behtareen tadbeer ke saath hi ek muddat-e-muayyan ke liye paida kiya hai, aur kaafir log jis cheez se daraaye jaate hain munh mod lete hain.
ayahs.4: Aap keh dijiye! Bhala dekho to jinhein tum Allah ke siwa pukaarte ho mujhe bhi to dikhao ke unhon ne zameen ka kaun sa tukda banaaya hai ya aasmanon mein un ka kaun sa hissa hai? Agar tum sachche ho to is se pehle hi ki koi kitaab ya koi ilm hi jo naql kiya jaata ho, mere paas laao.
ayahs.5: Aur is se badh kar gumraah aur kaun hoga? Jo Allah ke siwa aison ko pukaarata hai jo qayamat tak us ki dua qabool na kar saken balke un ke pukaarne se mehaz bekhabar hon.
ayahs.6: Aur jab logon ko jama kiya jaayega to yeh un ke dushman ho jaayenge aur un ki parastish se saaf inkaar kar jaayenge.
ayahs.7: Aur unhein jab hamari waazeh aayaten padh kar sunaayi jaati hain to munkir log sachchi baat ko jab ke un ke paas aa chuki, keh dete hain ke yeh to sareeh jaadu hai.
ayahs.8: Kya woh kehte hain ke ise to us ne khud ghad liya hai? Aap keh dijiye! Ke agar main hi ise bana laaya hoon to tum mere liye Allah ki taraf se kisi cheez ka ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte, tum is (Quran) ke baare mein jo kuchh keh sun rahe ho ise Allah khoob jaanta hai, mere aur tumhare darmiyan gawaahi ke liye wohi kaafi hai, aur woh bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.9: Aap keh dijiye! Ke main koi bilkul anokha Paighambar to nahin na mujhe yeh maloom hai ke mere saath aur tumhare saath kya kya kiya jaayega. Main to sirf isi ki pairwi karta hoon jo meri taraf wahi bheji jaati hai aur main to sirf alal-aalaan aagaah kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.10: Aap keh dijiye! Agar yeh (Quran) Allah hi ki taraf se ho aur tum ne ise na maana ho aur Bani Israeel ka ek gawaah is jaisi ki gawaahi bhi de chuka ho aur woh imaan bhi laa chuka ho aur tum ne sarkashi ki ho, to beshak Allah Taala zaalimon ko raah nahin dikhaata.
ayahs.11: Aur kaafiron ne imaan-daaron ki nisbat kaha ke agar yeh (deen) behtar hota to yeh log is ki taraf hum se sabaqat karne na paate, aur chunke unhon ne Quran se hidayat nahin paayi pas yeh keh denge ke qadeemi jhoot hai.
ayahs.12: Aur is se pehle Moosa ki kitaab peshwa aur rehmat thi. Aur yeh kitaab hai tasdeeq karne wali Arabi zabaan mein taake zaalimon ko daraaye aur nekokaaron ko basharat ho.
ayahs.13: Beshak jin logon ne kaha ke hamara Rabb Allah hai phir is par jame rahe to un par na to koi khauf hoga aur na ghamgeen honge.
ayahs.14: Yeh to ahl-e-jannat hain jo sada isi mein rahenge, un aamaal ke badle jo woh kiya karte the.
ayahs.15: Aur hum ne insaan ko apne maan baap ke saath husn-e-sulook karne ka hukm diya hai, us ki maan ne ise takleef jhel kar pet mein rakha aur takleef bardaasht karke ise jana. Us ke hamal ka aur us ke doodh chhudane ka zamaana tees maheene ka hai. Yahan tak ke jab woh pukhtagi aur chaalees saal ki umr ko pahuncha to kehne laga ae mere Parwardigaar! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri is ne'mat ka shukr baja laaun jo tu ne mujh par aur mere maan baap par in'aam ki hai aur yeh ke main aise nek amal karoon jin se tu khush ho jaaye aur tu meri aulaad bhi saaleh bana, main teri taraf ruju karta hoon aur main musalmanon mein se hoon.
ayahs.16: Yehi woh log hain jin ke nek aamaal to hum qabool farma lete hain aur jin ke bad-aamaal se darguzar kar lete hain, (yeh) jannati logon mein hain. Us sachche waade ke mutaabiq jo un se kiya jaata tha.
ayahs.17: Aur jis ne apne maan baap se kaha ke tum se main tang aa gaya, tum mujh se yehi kehte rahoge ke main marne ke baad phir zinda kiya jaaunga, mujh se pehle bhi ummaten guzar chuki hain, woh dono Janab-e-Baari mein fariyaden karte hain aur kehte hain tujhe kharabi ho tu imaan le aa, beshak Allah ka waada haq hai, woh jawab deta hai ke yeh to sirf aglon ke afsaane hain.
ayahs.18: Woh log hain jin par (Allah ke azaab ka) waada saadiq aa gaya, un jinnat aur insaanon ke girohon ke saath jo un se pehle guzar chuke hain, yaqeenan yeh nuqsaan paane wale the.
ayahs.19: Aur har ek ko apne apne aamaal ke mutaabiq darje milenge taake unhein un ke aamaal ke poore badle de aur un par zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.20: Aur jis din kaafir jahannam ke sire par laaye jaayenge (kaha jaayega) tum ne apni nekiyan dunya ki zindagi mein hi barbaad kar din aur un se faide utha chuke, pas aaj tumhein zillat ke azaab ki saza di jaayegi, is baais ke tum zameen mein na-haq takabbur kiya karte the aur is baais bhi ke tum hukm-udooli kiya karte the.
ayahs.21: Aur Aad ke bhai ko yaad karo, jabke us ne apni qaum ko Ahqaaf mein daraaya aur yaqeenan is se pehle bhi daraane wale guzar chuke hain aur is ke baad bhi yeh ke tum siwaaye Allah Taala ke aur kisi ki ibaadat na karo, beshak main tum par bade din ke azaab se khauf khaata hoon.
ayahs.22: Qaum ne jawab diya, kya aap hamare paas is liye aaye hain ke hamein apne maboodon (ki parastish) se baaz rakhen? Pas agar aap sachche hain to jis azaab ka aap waada karte hain ise hum par laa daalen.
ayahs.23: (Hazrat Hood ne) kaha (is ka) ilm to Allah hi ke paas hai, main to jo paighaam de kar bheja gaya tha woh tumhein pahuncha raha hoon lekin main dekhta hoon ke tum log naadaani kar rahe ho.
ayahs.24: Phir jab unhon ne azaab ko ba-soorat-e-baadal dekha apni waadiyon ki taraf aate hue to kehne lage, yeh abr hum par barasne wala hai, (nahin) balke darasal yeh abr woh (azaab) hai jis ki tum jaldi kar rahe the, hawa hai jis mein dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.25: Jo apne Rabb ke hukm se har cheez ko halaak kar degi, pas woh aise ho gaye ke bajuz un ke makaanat ke aur kuchh dikhaai na deta tha. Gunahgaaron ke giroh ko hum yunhi saza dete hain.
ayahs.26: Aur bilyaqeen hum ne (qaum-e-Aad) ko woh maqdoor diye the jo tumhein to diye bhi nahin aur hum ne unhein kaan aankhen aur dil bhi de rakhe the. Lekin un ke kaanon aur aankhon aur dilon ne unhein kuchh bhi nafa na pahunchaaya jabke woh Allah Taala ki aayaton ka inkaar karne lage aur jis cheez ka woh mazaaq udaaya karte the wohi un par ulat padi.
ayahs.27: Aur yaqeenan hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bastiyan tabaah kar din aur tarah tarah ki hum ne apni nishaniyan bayan kar din taake woh ruju kar len.
ayahs.28: Pas qurb-e-Ilahi haasil karne ke liye unhon ne Allah ke siwa jin jin ko apna mabood bana rakha tha unhon ne un ki madad kyun na ki? Balke woh to un se kho gaye, (balke darasal) yeh un ka mehaz jhoot aur (bilkul) bohtan tha.
ayahs.29: Aur yaad karo! Jabke hum ne jinon ki ek jamaat ko teri taraf mutawajjeh kiya ke woh Quran sunein, pas jab (Nabi ke) paas pahunch gaye to (ek doosre se) kehne lage khamosh ho jaao, phir jab padh kar khatam ho gaya to apni qaum ko khabardaar karne ke liye waapas laut gaye.
ayahs.30: Kehne lage ae hamari qaum! Hum ne yaqeenan woh kitaab suni hai jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) ke baad naazil ki gayi hai jo apne se pehli kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai jo sachche deen ki aur raah-e-raast ki taraf rahnumaai karti hai.
ayahs.31: Ae hamari qaum! Allah ke bulaane wale ka kaha maano, is par imaan laao, to Allah tumhare gunaah bakhsh dega aur tumhein alamnak azaab se panaah dega.
ayahs.32: Aur jo shakhs Allah ke bulaane wale ka kaha na maanega pas woh zameen mein kahin (bhaag kar Allah ko) aajiz nahin kar sakta, na Allah ke siwa aur koi is ke madadgaar honge, yeh log khuli gumraahi mein hain.
ayahs.33: Kya woh nahin dekhte ke jis Allah ne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya aur un ke paida karne se woh na thaka, woh yaqeenan murdon ko zinda karne par qaadir hai? Kyun na ho? Woh yaqeenan har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.34: Woh log jinhon ne kufr kiya jis din jahannam ke saamne laaye jaayenge (aur un se kaha jaayega ke) kya yeh haq nahin hai? To jawab denge ke haan qasam hai hamare Rabb ki (haq hai) (Allah) farmaayega, ab apne kufr ke badle azaab ka maza chakho.
ayahs.35: Pas (ae Paighambar!) tum aisa sabr karo jaisa sabr aali-himmat Rasoolon ne kiya aur un ke liye (azaab talab karne mein) jaldi na karo, yeh jis din is azaab ko dekh lenge jis ka waada diye jaate hain to (yeh maloom hone lagega ke) din ki ek ghadi hi (dunya mein) thehre the, yeh hai paighaam pahuncha dena, pas badkaaron ke siwa koi halaak na kiya jaayega.
